title: Bounded extremally disconnected cover of a profinite space
statement: Let $X$ be a profinite space, meaning a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected space (an object of $\mathbf{Prof}$ as defined in [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]) and $\lambda$ an infinite cardinal with $|X|\leq\lambda$. There exist a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected space $T$ and a continuous surjection $u:T\to X$ such that $T$ is extremally disconnected (the closure of every open subset is open) and $|T|\leq 2^{2^\lambda}$.

source.place: Topology, Tag 090D, lemma-existence-projective-cover; Tag 090E, remark-size-projective-cover; quasi-compact Hausdorff extremally disconnected spaces are profinite

proof.text: Use the Mathlib Stonean presentation of a profinite space. Set P := X.presentation and take T := Stonean.toProfinite.obj P with its canonical morphism to X, viewed as a ContinuousMap. The presentation map is epi and hence surjective by Profinite.epi_iff_surjective; P.prop gives ExtremallyDisconnected T.

For the cardinal estimate, unfold the presentation carrier to Ultrafilter X. Map an ultrafilter to the set of subsets represented by its underlying filter. Ultrafilter.ext proves this map injective. Cardinal.mk_le_of_injective and Cardinal.mk_set twice give #Ultrafilter X ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ #X), and monotonicity of cardinal exponentiation together with hX gives the desired bound.
